query:
SELECT mc.characterName, mc.cardNumber, mc.cardType, mc.parallels, ms.name as setName, ms.id as setId
FROM marvel_cards mc
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id
WHERE mc.characterName IN ('Spider-Man', 'Wolverine', 'Iron Man', 'Captain America', 'Thor', 'Mister Fantastic', 'Doctor Doom', 'Rogue', 'Hulk', 'Doctor Strange', 'Blade', 'Storm', 'Black Widow', 'Venom', 'Magneto', 'Daredevil', 'Professor X', 'Invisible Woman', 'Gambit', 'Black Panther')
ORDER BY mc.characterName, ms.name, mc.cardType
LIMIT 200;
